_nota: Manuale del brand di Cinque Foglie (inventato).
missione: Helping people who aren't experts discover good tea, explaining everything simply.

valori.cosa: We explain what's in the cup and how to brew it, without expert jargon.
We buy from small organic growers and say who they are.
We make people want to try a new tea, without judging those who only drink chamomile.

siamo: Calm: no shouting, no fake urgency
regole: We talk to people directly and warmly, always: never stiff, formal language.
No capitals for shouting and no «!!!».
One thing at a time: the concrete benefit first, then the details.
Emoji are fine only on social media, one per text at most.
No health claims: teas and herbal teas are foods.

esempi.prima: Dear customer, we hereby inform you that the product is available.
esempi.dopo: Good news: your favourite tea is back.

logo: Five stylised leaves in a circle. On a light background it's dark green, on a dark background white. It's never distorted and its colour never changes.
